contentHtml:
What are UAE Medical Test Failure Reasons?

Infectious diseases, chronic conditions, and other health problems are the most common reasons for UAE medical test failures. The UAE requires certain health standards for certain jobs. You may be restricted from finding employment in UAE if your medical test fails.

Although the country offers great employment opportunities, people cannot enter with a medical test failed UAE in certain circumstances. These exams are a primary requirement that the authorities require for all foreigners. Additionally, for those who wish to renew their visa, it is also essential not to have any contagious disease.

In this article, we will explain everything related to this exam, such as what it consists of and what the cost is. Moreover, you will learn what are the consequences of not passing any of the tests and what you will have to do in this case. Let us see:

Who Needs UAE Medical Test for Visa?

All people must pass a medical test for UAE visa to obtain this permission to stay in the country. Said examination is an essential requirement for foreigners since its establishment by the Cooperation Council in 1995. In this sense, the authorities seek to track communicable diseases among people who want to enter the country.

In the same way, there is a medical test for visa renewal to stay longer in the United Arab Emirates. Thus, both for the renewal, as well as for the first visa, the person must take a test to detect HIV. You will also have to pass a chest X-ray to detect traces of tuberculosis.

Additionally, there are certain categories of employees who are required to pass a UAE medical test for visa. In this case, we refer to the tests for hepatitis B and syphilis, which must pass the following categories:

  • Domestic workers
  • Food workers
  • People who work in nurseries
  • Salon workers
  • Health personnel

Similarly, domestic workers must have a negative pregnancy test. For each of the medical examinations, the visa applicant must take them in the government health facilities. Examinations in private clinics are not allowed and a medical test failed UAE brings negative consequences for the applicant.

Documents required for the

As for the UAE medical test for visa 2016, at present you will need to submit the following documents:

  • A copy of your current passport
  • A copy of the valid residence permit
  • 2 passport-sized photographs with a white background
  • Copy of UAE ID (for visa renewal only).

Cost of medical tests for UAE visa

If you want to take the medical test for visa in Dubai without the vaccination, you will need to pay the corresponding amount of AED 260. On the other hand, for the medical test that includes the vaccination, the amount is AED 310. Also, if you want to get the medical examination to hire a maid, you will need to pay AED 360 for the service.

However, the costs may vary depending on where you take the medical tests for UAE visa. For example, in the Preventive Medicine Department of the Ministry of Health and Prevention (Mohap), the cost is AED 105. Likewise, you can find places to take these tests in shopping malls, where it costs AED 110.

Abu Dhabi Health Department, HAAD

To take a medical test for employment visa in Abu Dhabi at HAAD, you will need to pay AED 250. In addition, you can also get a result certificate for the Hepatitis B vaccine at this place. In this case, you will need to pay AED 50.

Dubai Health Authority (DHA)

On the typing centers of this department, you will also be able to take the Dubai visa renewal medical test. The cost, to obtain the certificate in a specific time, is the one that we will detail below:

  • To get it within 5 business days, AED 322.5
  • If you want to get it within 48 hours, AED 432.5
  • To get it within 24 hours, AED 532.5
  • AED 752.5 to get it within 4 hours (VIP request)

However, for expatriates with a domestic worker visa, the costs are a little higher:

  • To get it within 5 business days, AED 372.5
  • If you want to get it within 48 hours, AED 482.5
  • To get it within 24 hours, AED 582.5
  • AED 802.5 to get it within 4 hours (VIP request)

What does a medical test failed UAE mean?

All expatriates must undergo various medical examinations, which include a test for tuberculosis. Therefore, if the presence is detected, or active TB or scars, you will get a medical test failed UAE. However, this person may obtain a conditional aptitude certificate and a residence visa valid for one year.

This will occur while the person is receiving tuberculosis treatment during their stay in the United Arab Emirates. If the employer wants to terminate the contract for this reason, you will need to leave the country. Therefore, consider this situation in case of a medical test failed UAE so that you seek the necessary advice.

What is next after the medical test failed UAE?

In previous years there have been cases in which people have obtained a positive result for a disease. For example, in 2014, of 83,268 people who took this test, 366 patients had one of these diseases. Likewise, they demanded people who failed UAE medical test for visa 2021 and had to return to their home country.

In most cases, the countries of origin of people with a Dubai medical test fail do not have a pre-testing program. Also, while some people may be granted a permit in certain cases, most must return to their country of origin. Therefore, this information is essential for those who wish to enter the country for any reason.

Despite the aforementioned, there are cases in which the unfit medical certificate UAE is due to a past illness.Thus, if this happens, the person involved should contact the embassy of their country in the UAE. You will need to do this to obtain reports certifying that the exam failed because of scars from previous illnesses.

In the same way, said reports must certify that the disease is completely cured and a notarial certificate must be added. Also, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (the country of origin) and the UAE embassy will have to legalize it. After certifying the document, you must consign it to the UAE Ministry of Health.

What happens if you do not pass the medical test for visa renewal in Dubai?

As with the UAE medical test for visa renewal 2021, you will need to pass the current ones to stay in the country. Thus, in case of failure, you will have to quit your job and the employer will pay for the ticket back to your country. Likewise, if the detected disease is contagious, you must remain in quarantine until the day of departure from the UAE.

Centers for medical test for UAE visa

In the United Arab Emirates, you can find several health centers authorized to obtain visa fit medical result. Therefore, we will show you which are these centers in each of the Emirates:

  • Abu Dhabi. At SEHA Medical Center, you can also get the visa fit medical result online SEHA.
  • Dubai. Authorized centers are Salah El Deen Center, Al Khubaisi Medical Center, Al Nahda Center, and Dragon Mart 2 Center. Moreover, you can go to Al Karama Center, Spring Souk Center, Ibn Battuta Center, Tecom Center, and Al Baraha Smart Center.
  • Ajman. The authorized centers for the examination are the Al Hamidiya Center and the Mushairif Center.
  • Sharjah. The medical test for visa in Sharjah can be taken atKalbaa, Al Dhaid, Khorfakkan, and Dibba Al Hosn public health centers. You can also go to the Sahara, Al Khibrah, and Allbdaa medical centers.
  • Ras Al Khaimah. In this emirate, you can go to the Dahan Center.
  • Fujairah. The authorized center for the medical examination is the Torre Mina Center.
  • Umm al-Quwain. Here you can visit the Preventive Medicine Center in Umm Al Quwain to take the test.

UAE Visa Medical Result Verification

You can check the results of the SEHA medical screening for visa Abu Dhabi results or Dubai visa. In both cases, you can view the results online for your convenience and decide what you should do in any case.

Verification of results for the exam in Dubai

In case you have taken the medical test for visa in Dubai at the DHA, you can check the status online. To do this, you can follow the steps that we will describe below:

  1. Download the Dubai Health Authority (DHA) app.
  2. Create a DHA account or use your UAE pass.
  3. Enter your username and password to log in in case you use the first option.
  4. Then, select the service option at the top of the screen and select “other services”.
  5. Select “Check Medical Aptitude Test Status”.
  6. Enter the application reference number, which you should have received by SMS after the medical test.
  7. Next, enter your date of birth and your passport number.
  8. Click on “check status”.

After you have entered all this information, you will be able to know the status of your medical examination, which may be in progress or completed. These results are usually available on the site within 24 hours of taking the test.

Verification of results in Abu Dhabi

If you are wondering, how can I check my SEHA medical result? You only have to enter the TAMM platform, which is authorized by the government for this purpose. In this case, you will not need to register to check the status of your medical exam, just follow these steps:

  1. Enter the official TAMM site.
  2. Once there, select “Visa Screening Result”.
  3. You will then need to enter the application number that you received in an SMS after the exam was completed.
  4. Next, you need to enter your UID (Unified Identification Number). You can find it on the residence visa page of your passport.
  5. Then, solve the captcha and select “Submit”.

If you follow the steps properly, you will be able to see the status of your medical test, the result of which you will able to know between 24 and 48 hours. However, if the results do not appear, you can follow up with SEHA, the testing company. You can also locate the results through the Abu Dhabi Department of Health (DOH), the supervisory authority for medical services.

In case of a failed medical test in UAE, you should know what to do

Medical examinations are mandatory for all foreigners who want to live and work in the United Arab Emirates. These exams must be taken at medical centers authorized by the authorities for them to be valid. In addition, those people who fail any of the tests must return to their country or opt for other options in certain cases.
